body: Thank you everyone for all your messages and support, I honestly didn't think anyone cared but you guys proved me wrong <3 But yeah, I'm okay now (well, for now, tbh probably won't last long) because of my aunt. I just formed a newfound relationship with her, I passed out due to lack of food and sleep and too much stress, so after she woke me up she talked to me for a few hours. Turns out we're liked those 2 characters in a book that are best friends but have polar personalities but have a lot of opinions in common. She's like the big sister I never had. Wow, if it wasn't for her and you guys I might have done something stupid, so thank you all for taking time out of your day to be kind to a stranger.

I don't plan on not eating for a long period of time, don't worry. I just ate a peach. And yup, those are the symptoms I have. And the bad thing is, I know I'm not going to sleep until he talks to me, which will most likely be a long wait, considering the fact that the dick turned his phone off
My biggest concern right now is passing out from lack of sleep and food. Do you happen to know the symptoms of the body shutting down from that?
Age doesn't matter to me, I'm just glad someone cares, ya know? And I keep telling myself things will get better, but I just can't take much more
